main.description: Get the current commit for an account's permissioned repo within a space. Served by a repo host. Callable with either OAuth (for the authenticated user's own data) or a space credential (for syncing services). When called with a space credential, the caller must request a MAC with an Accept-Signature header (tag atproto-space-commit), and the response carries it in Signature-Input and Signature headers covering an Atproto-Space-Commit header.

repo.description: The DID of the account whose latest commit to retrieve.

errors.name: InvalidSpaceMac
errors.description: The MAC requested in the Accept-Signature header is missing or invalid.
